facts.fact: RFI reports that public administrations in the Central African Republic transfer employees' monthly salaries into bank accounts between the 20th and 30th of each month, though provincial civil servants must travel to Bangui to collect them.

CAF.note: No survey share of adults with an account is given.

facts.fact: RFI reports that a civil servant in Kaga-Bandoro receives money transferred to his Orange Money account and withdraws it at local kiosks, though cash liquidity there is scarce.

CAF.note: Document does not mention tax or fee payment.
